title: Describe Role
prompt: A TypeScript admin panel shows friendly labels for user roles. Write a function that maps "admin" to "Administrator", "editor" to "Editor", and "viewer" to "Viewer".

explanation.beginner:
Example: describeRole("admin") produces "Administrator". The result must follow this precise rule: A TypeScript admin panel shows friendly labels for user roles. Write a function that maps "admin" to "Administrator", "editor" to "Editor", and "viewer" to "Viewer". Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “describes editors”: input ["editor"] produces "Editor". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.
